name: testdriverai
title_zh: 让 AI 像真人一样点开浏览器跑完回归测试
tagline_zh: 写断言太累、录屏脚本一改 UI 就全废？给它一句自然语言任务，它自己开浏览器点按钮、填表单、截图比对。
tagline_en: Stop hand-writing brittle selectors. Give it a plain-English task; it drives the browser, clicks, types.
desc_en: Computer-Use SDK for E2E QA Testing
why_zh: 把「看屏幕决定下一步」做成 SDK 原语，不是把 Playwright 包一层。
why_en: Screen-reading is a first-class primitive, not a wrapper over Playwright. Failures come back as a visual evidence trail, not a.
limit_zh: 它跑的是真实浏览器，所以本机要有可用的 Chromium 和能访问被测站点的网络；纯 API 层、单元测试。
limit_en: Needs a real Chromium and network access to the target site. No API-only, unit, or native mobile testing. Visual checks read screenshots, so.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: AI that clicks through your app like a real QA tester
